description: This file contains Orleans grain implementations related to stream reliability testing. It defines grain state, grain classes, and methods for managing streams, producers, consumers, and subscriptions within a distributed Orleans-based streaming system.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable state class for the stream reliability test grain, storing stream provider name, stream object, producer status, and consumer subscription handles, with generics for various stream types.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTestGrain<T>
classes.description: Generic Orleans grain implementing stream reliability tests, capable of acting as producer and consumer, managing stream subscriptions, and maintaining state.

classes.name: StreamUnsubscribeTestGrain
classes.description: Grain class for testing stream unsubscribe functionality, enabling subscribe/unsubscribe to streams and managing their handles.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initialization logic when the grain is activated, restoring stream handles and producer state.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Logic to run when the grain is deactivated.

methods.name: GetConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of current consumers subscribed to the stream.

methods.name: GetReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of items received by all consumers.

methods.name: GetErrorsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of errors encountered by consumers.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Simple method to test liveness.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a new consumer subscription to a specified stream.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a specific consumer subscription.

methods.name: RemoveAllConsumers
methods.description: Removes all current consumer subscriptions.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Designates the grain as a producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: RemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes producer status from the grain.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears all state and subscriptions on the grain.

methods.name: IsConsumer
methods.description: Checks if the grain has consumer subscriptions.

methods.name: IsProducer
methods.description: Checks if the grain is configured as a producer.

methods.name: GetConsumerHandlesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of consumer subscription handles.

methods.name: GetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Returns the count of active consumer observers.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends a data item into the stream as a producer.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Returns the address/location of the silo hosting the grain.

methods.name: TryInitStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream object based on stream ID and provider name.

methods.name: ReconnectConsumerHandles
methods.description: Reconnects and resumes previous consumer subscription handles.
